reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**, from *Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth* (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments from the gatehouse kiosk. A patch went in that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the problem was fixed.
2. **#4419**, from *Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)* (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 during third shift. It went to tier-2 support for firmware testing. The cheat sheet has no date, so I can't tell how current this is.

Moss's other two North notes (9/14 pipeline and 3/23 renewal) mention QFL but have no ticket numbers. The Central notes list tickets #4409 and #4412 and FR-882, but those belong to Marrow accounts, not QFL. I only searched Moss's notes in the shared files, not the account ticket folder, so this may not be every QFL ticket.
